strNotes: Translation catalogs with English fallback; language selection through Phobos Framework. Shared native definitions, mass-balanced construction, inventory and physical item transfers, filters, clocks, grid routes and saved sender/receiver pairing. Requires BepInEx 5 and the PhobosFramework plugin. No Crafting Framework, Salvage Workshop or Shipbreaker dependency. Links persist in native saves; transport progress and scheduling remain the equipment mod's responsibility. Equipment economy: additive merchant stock, condition-aware offers, construction tools, mass-balanced service and dismantling. Ordinary saves supported; economy integration awaits gameplay validation. Shared immutable processing jobs and mass accounting. Version 0.9.0 adds persistent exact-ID port filters, independent of saved pairs and native wiring. Version 0.10.0 adds shared console access checks and scrollable panel widgets. Version 0.11.0 adds native versioned object-state storage with owner checks and protection of unsupported records.
